name: SSL4EO-S12: Self-Supervised Learning for Earth Observation with Sentinel-1/2
description: SSL4EO-S12 is a global, multi-modal satellite imagery dataset created by the Technical University of Munich (TUM) to benchmark self-supervised pre-training algorithms for Earth observation. Sourced across 251,079 globally sampled locations, each location includes multi-temporal patches (4 seasons) from Sentinel-1 (C-band dual-polarization SAR) and Sentinel-2 (Level-1C top-of-atmosphere and Level-2A bottom-of-atmosphere multi-spectral bands), providing over 3 million multi-spectral satellite image patches (264x264 pixels) spanning 14 spectral bands.
